title: Dispersion Relations Across the Unitarity Boundary
summary: Kramers-Kronig (KK) relations rest on a binary premise: a response function is either analytic in the upper half-plane or it is not. We show that a single reduced-state transform organizes both outcomes into a sharp dichotomy controlled by microscopic unitarity. One closed-form function carries, simultaneously, a zero and a pole in the upper half-plane; the spectral abscissa alpha of the reduced propagator decides which is realized.
